_headline.note: This is an UPPER BOUND on what the split throws away by not letting the pitch model see the drums, measured with no model at all. It is same-step only: a leak across steps would add to it. Compare it against the measured bits/second gap in split_report.py - if the gap is much larger than this, the gap is not caused by the factorisation but by the duplicated clock or by the training budget.
